title: Research: realize sharp T16 integer profiles in the call windows
body:
## Summary

Call-window eligibility alone does not tighten PR3378's sharp pooled T16 integer bound. Both optimal profiles admit exact temporal assignments on the unchanged selected1094 chronology.

```text
PR3378 pooled optimum on 0 <= a <= 1/2
+ both inventories realized in literal call windows
= the same sharp temporal-relaxation optimum
```

Each witness assigns all 69,120 whole helpers to 32,256 disjoint-capacity bins. The package includes the integer certificate, constructive proof, source hashes, standalone checker, controls and replay instructions. Base is canonical `6f100d4bb5083f8c35d96fd95a539811c62f245c`, priority revision 6. [Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1885#discussioncomment-19008655).

## Evidence

- **Before:** PR3352/3378 supplied sharp pooled inventories while temporal/physical attainment remained open.
  **After:** exact group/width/call equations and a separate literal row checker certify both temporal assignments. Seven behavioral groups reject time, inventory, capacity, identity and actual optimized source-byte corruptions.
- Registered Python 3.12 replay, optimized verifier/tests, repository Ruff diagnostics and read-only Git-free replay of actual committed bytes pass. The pinned PR3378 committed export separately passes all 56,987 lower-bound continuum obligations.
- Replay: `python3.12 -I -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/t16-window-cap`.

This is a scoped negative result about strengthening the packing relaxation. Family identity and active-pair compatibility remain omitted. No physical owner map, native/supplier admission, full selected replay, new kappa or selected-frontier update is claimed. The external predecessor lower-bound dependency and its separate replay are explicit.

Credit Ali Romman/PR1129, Hanson Sun/PR1914, PR3352/3364/3378, Rohan Arun, Jeremy Kothe, Hao Yan, Chafik Boukhalfa and the retained selected-source lineage. Concurrent physical owner-map improvements address a stricter problem.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** isolated

Eight new files under `research/t16-window-cap`; no frozen source, shared implementation or selected record changes.
